question: A consultant wants Claude to use British spelling and metric units in every conversation, no matter which piece of work it belongs to. Where does that direction best belong?
options: A) In the account-wide instructions, since the preference applies to all conversations rather than one workspace.
B) In the instructions of each project, repeated so that every workspace carries the same spelling rule.
C) In the opening message of each chat, restated whenever the consultant begins any new piece of work.
D) In a document uploaded to each project's knowledge base, so that Claude reads the rule as general background material.
correct_answers: A) In the account-wide instructions, since the preference applies to all conversations rather than one workspace.
explanations: Correct. Account-wide instructions are the place for direction that should hold across every conversation.
This works only inside projects that were remembered, and every new project has to be updated by hand.
Repeating it forever is exactly the manual overhead durable configuration is meant to remove.
Knowledge is reference material for a project, not a standing behaviour rule, and it misses plain chats.
